content.comment_body: Hello! Is it common for the time to be shown in hexadecimal format?

Yes, that's standard, though you can adjust it using a text editor. For reference, check the topic discussing how to remove the hex notation (16#) from weekly timer switch times on the extended web server.

They are unclear if this is standard or adjustable. One user notes this is typical but suggests customization is possible with a text editor, though built-in options are limited.
